pr.title: Add phase management MCP tools (advance, start, complete, populate)
pr.description:
Exposes four phase management operations as MCP tools for pipeline recovery
and manual intervention, eliminating the need for raw curl calls during
stuck pipeline scenarios. The advance_phase tool with force=true also stops
running containers before advancing to prevent SIGTERM cascading.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: unit tests in test_mcp_tools.py for all 4 handlers
- Manual: verify tools appear in MCP server tool list
